title: Glossary entry (glossary/<name>.json), format version 1
description: One explicit glossary entry. It holds translation keys only; the texts come from the texts files of the same mod. The key names are listed in include/match/modload/glossary_entries.hpp; a test compares both. An explicit entry replaces the automatic entry of a card with the same id, inside the same mod only. A mod defines ids only in its own namespace, and only the uni mod defines uni: ids (loader check glossary.id.namespace). The key syntax and the key namespace are semantic checks (glossary.key.syntax, glossary.key.namespace).

uni:format_version.description: Version of the file style. This build reads major version 1.

uni:identifier.description: Full entry id, namespace:name. The namespace is the id of the defining mod.

uni:label_key.description: Translation key of the label. A key, never a text.

uni:description_key.description: Translation key of the description. A key, never a text.
